subject: QMon onboarding: prompt/eval activation and canary/rollback playbook
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Jamie Torres <jamie@blueskyhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Jul 2028 15:14:00 -0700
Subject: QMon onboarding: initial plan and deliverables

Hi team / Jamie,

Thanks again for the call today — great alignment on objectives. I wanted to capture the proposed rollout and immediate deliverables so we have a single source of truth: 

1) Prompt sets: we will activate the first prompt suite (attached: prompt_set_initial.json) into the eval harness for smoke tests. Goal: exercise the top 12 user flows and the three known edge-cases we discussed.

2) Eval harness integration: Marissa will onboard the harness into BlueSky’s staging environment using eval_harness_v1.yml. Expected artifacts from BlueSky: a sample of 1k user prompts, redaction guidance, and any deterministic evaluation labels you already have.

3) Regression alerts and canary windows: propose an initial 72-hour canary with thresholds (drafted below). If regressions show up, we’ll trigger rollback and the post-mortem cadence.

Proposed canary thresholds (initial):
- Semantic regression: > 3% drop in eval accuracy on core prompt set
- Latency: median 95th -> increase > 20% vs baseline
- Token unit cost: unexpected increase > 15%

Next actions:
- Jamie: confirm the 1k sample and whether we have any labeled eval data by EOD Thursday.
- Marissa: start harness setup in staging; ping when collection endpoint is ready.
- Monica: confirm monitoring hooks (SLOs, alert routing) and who will be on the on-call for the canary window.

Attachments: prompt_set_initial.json (stub), eval_harness_v1.yml (stub), qmon_telemetry_schema.csv (stub)

Naomi Feldman
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Jamie Torres <jamie@blueskyhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Jul 2028 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QMon onboarding: initial plan and deliverables

On Tue, Jul 25, 2028 at 3:14 PM Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks again for the call today — great alignment on objectives. I wanted to capture the proposed rollout and immediate deliverables so we have a single source of truth:
>
> 1) Prompt sets: we will activate the first prompt suite (attached: prompt_set_initial.json) into the eval harness for smoke tests.

Agree with the plan. A few clarifications and requests from the implementation side: 

- Harness infra: I’ll provision the harness runner in BlueSky staging. I need an endpoint where staging can POST logs and evaluation results — Naomi, can you share the telemetry schema (I saw qmon_telemetry_schema.csv attached but want to confirm field naming)?
- Canary tuning: suggest we add an early-warning metric for hallucination spikes (syntactic hallucination rate) — flag if >2% in first 24 hours.
- Rollback policy: what’s the agreed window to perform a manual rollback before auto-fallback? I recommend 30 minutes for manual review during business hours; auto-fallback after sustained breach for 60 minutes.

Deliverable timeline:
- Today: Marissa will upload the harness config and open the collector endpoint.
- Thu EOD: Jamie to provide 1k sample & any existing labels.
- Mon: dry-run of canary in internal staging, smoke checks.

Marissa Cole
Platform Implementation Lead, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
From: Jamie Torres <jamie@blueskyhealth.com>

Subject: Re: QMon onboarding: initial plan and deliverables

Thanks Naomi — this looks good. Quick notes from BlueSky: 

- We can deliver the 1k anonymized prompt sample by Thu EOD, and we have ~200 labeled examples for core flows (will include in the upload).
- Security: our security team needs the SOC2 artifacts and a short note on KMS integration for keying telemetry (we can share an inventory). Is there a standard artifact bundle you normally provide?
- Legal: Perry is cc’d and will review the canary rollback language in the contract addendum — he’s flagged the auto-fallback window as something to confirm.

Alex and I are available for a short run-through on Friday if you want to walk the harness flow.

—Jamie

Jamie — fantastic, thanks for the quick turnaround. A few concrete items from our side: 

- SOC2/KMS: Naomi (me) to send the standard security artifacts bundle and a 1-pager on how telemetry keys are handled with our KMS integration. Expect a Drive link in the next message.
- Canary windows / rollback: we’ll implement Marissa’s recommendation: 30-minute manual review window during business hours, auto-fallback after sustained threshold breach for 60 minutes. We’ll document exact timelines in the Canary_Rollback_Runbook.pdf (attached).
- Early-warning metrics: adding hallucination spike detection as Marissa suggested; set initial alert at 2% in first 24 hours.

I’ve started a DocuSign for the addendum (link below). Please have legal review and sign so we can proceed to the scheduled canary next week.

- Rollout calendar:
  * Tue 2028-08-01 09:00 PT — staging dry-run (internal)
  * Wed 2028-08-02 10:00 PT — BlueSky staging canary start (72-hour window)
  * Sat 2028-08-05 18:00 PT — canary review & decide on promotion/rollback

- On-call & alerts: Sean Gallagher will be primary on-call for the canary window, Laura will be escalation for engineering, Marissa will own harness issues.
- Attachments: confirm you all received prompt_set_initial.json, eval_harness_v1.yml, Canary_Rollback_Runbook.pdf and qmon_telemetry_schema.csv.

If no objections, we’ll proceed with the staging dry-run on Tue and keep all parties updated in this thread.
